items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 11 at 1:38PM EDT until October 11 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...A high risk for rip currents.

* WHERE...In North Carolina, Eastern Currituck County. In
Virginia, Virginia Beach.

* WHEN...Until 8 PM EDT this evening.

* IMPACTS...Dangerous swimming and surfing conditions.
items.instruction: Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.

items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued October 11 at 4:55PM EDT until October 12 at 6:00PM EDT by NWS Wakefield VA
items.description:
* WHAT...South winds 15 to 20 kt, becoming southwest, then
shifting to the northwest at 20 to 25 kt on Monday. Seas 6 to
8 ft, subsiding to 5 to 6 ft.

* WHERE...Coastal waters from NC VA border to Currituck Beach
Light NC out 20 NM.

* WHEN...Until 6 PM EDT Monday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
